note_tweet.text:
这是7年前的今天，我上高三的时候，晚上放学和两三个同学一起出来骑单车逛到了一个比较远的地方去，然后回家的时候在QQ空间写下的一段话：

The cool but a little stuffy wind kept running towards us. At first, I didn't hope to ride so far away from home, but some wild desire in my heart led me here. One valuable thing I thirsted for was the tinges, which made the vision for me that my goddess just stayed by my side. And we could just fly everywhere freely.
Oh, the goddess would not be vital if my princess woke up from her deep sleep and beautiful dream and came to me here! It's strange that simultaneously I just think of giving up the unreasonable idea.
